No photo shows origin labels, import documents, or a UK power plug.

The report states that whether the console powers on and functions is not shown.

risks.risk: Console does not power on or has internal faults.
risks.proof: Video of the console booting to the home screen and navigating menus.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-working console for parts only.

risks.risk: Controller buttons, sticks, or touchpad are faulty.
risks.proof: Video of the controller paired and used to navigate the console, testing all inputs.

risks.risk: Internal storage capacity is lower than expected.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the system storage settings showing the installed capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the lowest-capacity variant of the model.

risks.risk: Original box, manuals, or accessories are missing.
risks.proof: Photo of the original packaging, manuals, and any included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as console and controller only, with no box or paperwork.

risks.risk: Age and usage history are unknown; heavy wear may be hidden by plastic wrap.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the console exterior and serial number, plus any purchase receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a high-usage unit with unknown lifespan.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the front or top of the console showing the brand and model.
Video of the console powering on and operating.
Video of the controller working with the console.
Screenshot of the storage capacity settings.
Photo of any original box, manuals, or receipts.
response.reason: The witness identifies a game console and controller but cannot read the brand or model, so the seller's PS4 Slim claim is unproven and even a worst-case price cannot be set without a model-identifying shot.
